{"id": "de7f8376-57a6-4ac7-8241-740d4f1bd923", "role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Before we merge PR #57 in acme/payments-infra, how much more or less will it cost per month? It deploys to eu-west-1.
The attached material is what the repository integration and the AWS tools returned for this change. It is a synthetic test fixture: resource names, account results, SKUs and rates are made up, and the rates intentionally differ from real AWS list prices, so treat the rows below as the live lookup results for this run.
--- PR #57 (chore/bump-db-class -> main), files changed ---
cloudformation/payments-ledger.yaml   (+2 -2)
--- diff ---
@@ Parameters @@
   DbInstanceClass:
     Type: String
-    Default: db.r6g.large
+    Default: db.r6g.xlarge
@@ Resources.LedgerDb.Properties.Tags @@
       - Key: CostCenter
-        Value: payments
+        Value: payments-core
--- context (unchanged in this PR) ---
Resources.LedgerDb: AWS::RDS::DBInstance, DBInstanceClass: !Ref DbInstanceClass, Engine: postgres, MultiAZ: true, StorageType: gp3, AllocatedStorage: 200
.github/workflows/deploy.yml: AWS_REGION: eu-west-1; `aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name payments-ledger` with no --parameter-overrides (template defaults apply)
--- live lookup results for this run (AWS Price List, eu-west-1) ---
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-01  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.large    databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.500 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-03  usagetype EU-Multi-AZUsage:db.r6g.xlarge   databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   1.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-04  usagetype EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge        databaseEngine=PostgreSQL deploymentOption=Multi-AZ   0.000 USD per Hrs
AmazonRDS  SKU FX-RDS-02  usagetype EU-RDS:Multi-AZ-GP3-Storage       volumeType=General Purpose-GP3 databaseEngine=PostgreSQL   0.250 USD per GB-Mo", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
{"id": "a3df7284-a4fd-4ff3-a6d7-3d3874c55338", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "chat_title", "title": "RDS database class upgrade cost impact analysis"}]}

{"id": "dc78b1b6-5c06-4399-ad35-e727e101aa3f", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "I'm working out the cost delta from upsizing the instance class while Multi-AZ, storage, and engine stay the same, since the CostCenter tag change has no cost impact—comparing hourly Multi-AZ pricing between the large and xlarge tiers.

Using 730 hours per month, the increase is roughly $0.50/hr more, so about $365/month extra for the instance itself, while storage costs stay flat at $50/month since the 200 GB gp3 allocation isn't changing in this diff.

Total monthly cost goes from about $415 to $780, a $365 increase. The "EU-UnusedBox" SKU priced at $0.000/hr appears irrelevant to this calculation. This is a straightforward computation from the given fixture data, so I don't need any tools — I can just present the answer directly.

"}]}

{"id": "0c79503e-d588-4198-89db-6ba6e059f449", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Looking at the diff, the only functional change is the `DbInstanceClass` default moving from `db.r6g.large` → `db.r6g.xlarge` for the `LedgerDb` RDS instance (Multi-AZ, PostgreSQL). The CostCenter tag edit has no cost impact. Since the deploy workflow runs `cloudformation deploy` with no `--parameter-overrides`, the new template default will actually take effect on deploy.

**Rate lookup (eu-west-1, Multi-AZ PostgreSQL):**
- `db.r6g.large`: $0.500/hr
- `db.r6g.xlarge`: $1.000/hr
- Storage (gp3): $0.250/GB-mo — unchanged (AllocatedStorage stays at 200 GB)

**Monthly impact (using 730 hrs/month):**
| | Before (large) | After (xlarge) |
|---|---|---|
| Instance | $365.00 | $730.00 |
| Storage (200 GB) | $50.00 | $50.00 (no change) |
| **Total** | **$415.00** | **$780.00** |

**Net change: +$365.00/month increase** (instance compute cost doubles; storage is unaffected since this PR doesn't touch `AllocatedStorage` or `StorageType`).

That extra "EU-UnusedBox:db.r6g.xlarge" line at $0.000/hr doesn't factor in — it's a zero-rated SKU component, not an added cost.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
